occupations.title: Artists and Related Workers, All Other

knowledge_weighting.method: entry-weighted mean of O*NET 31.0 importance (Scale IM): entry targets weight 2; other linked occupations in Job Zone 4 or 5 (or the entry targets' Job Zone) weight 1; Manager, Chief, Postsecondary-faculty, All Other, Supervisor, Director and Treasurers and Controllers titles, and non-target occupations in other Job Zones, weight 0
knowledge_weighting.note: top_knowledge/top_skills are the unweighted mean over all linked occupations (kept for comparison); the outline uses the entry-weighted lists.

skipped_knowledge.reason: service and client-relations knowledge; the outline leaves it to internships, part-time work and the practice tasks rather than a course slot

outline_elements.rule: English Language is placed in Year 1 general education; workplace and management elements (Customer and Personal Service, Administrative, Clerical, Administration and Management, Personnel and Human Resources, Education and Training) get no course slot unless the major's CIP series is about them; the next three elements go to Year 2 and up to three more (ordered by importance to the entry targets) to Year 3; if fewer than two remain for Year 3, knowledge rated at least 2.5 for the entry targets fills it

method.supervisory_tasks: task statement matches a supervisory/managerial pattern (supervise, provide supervision, direct and coordinate, direct the work/activities/staff of, manage staff/personnel/employees/workers/teams, oversee the work/staff, hire, subordinates, assign work to, evaluate the work/performance of, train and supervise); 'under supervision' does not count
method.topical_overlap: a target is flagged low_title_overlap (severity high if its O*NET description also shares no stem, else medium) when its O*NET occupation title shares no content-word stem with the CIP program title (lower-cased words of 3+ letters; generic words such as science, studies, technology, engineering, management, services, general and other ignored; crude suffix stripping; stems of 5+ letters also match when one contains the other). The detail says whether the occupation's O*NET description shares a stem. This is a crude lexical heuristic: it misses implausible pairs that share a word and flags plausible pairs that use different words

flags.detail: description shares a stem with the CIP title
supervisory/managerial tasks of the entry targets were skipped when picking practice tasks

entry_target_basis: Job Zone 4 linked occupations (excluding Manager/Chief/Postsecondary/All Other/Supervisor/Director/Treasurers and Controllers titles), ranked by similarity of their O*NET knowledge-importance profile to the average profile of the eligible linked occupations (Pearson correlation), base O*NET-SOC .00 codes first

entry_target_review.note: Generated tier: rule output used as is; not reviewed for plausibility.
